title: Globalstar Rallies on Report That Amazon Is in Buyout Talks
title_zh: 有报道称亚马逊正在进行收购谈判，Globalstar 股价上涨
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Globalstar Inc. shares jumped more than 20% in late trading on a Financial Times report that Amazon.com Inc. is in talks to acquire the satellite provider.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——英国《金融时报》报道亚马逊公司正在洽谈收购卫星提供商事宜后，Globalstar Inc. 股价在尾盘交易中上涨了 20% 以上。

title: Amazon eyes $9 billion Globalstar deal to rival SpaceX's Starlink, FT reports
title_zh: 据英国《金融时报》报道，亚马逊计划以 90 亿美元收购 Globalstar，以与 SpaceX 的 Starlink 竞争
summary: Amazon is in talks to buy satellite telecom group Globalstar as it ramps up efforts to build its own ‌low-earth-orbit satellite business to rival SpaceX's Starlink, the Financial Times reported ‌on Wednesday, citing people familiar with the matter.
summary_zh: 据英国《金融时报》周三援引知情人士的话报道，亚马逊正在就收购卫星电信集团 Globalstar 进行谈判，该公司正在加大力度建立自己的低地球轨道卫星业务，以与 SpaceX 的 Starlink 竞争。

title: Intel stock climbs more than 9% on chip plant buyout news
title_zh: 英特尔股价因芯片工厂收购消息上涨逾 9%
summary: Intel stock climbed on Wednesday as the company moved to repurchase an equity stake it previously sold in one of its chip plants.
summary_zh: 英特尔股价周三上涨，因该公司采取行动回购之前出售的一家芯片工厂的股权。

title: Intel Jumps 8%, AMD Rises 3%: A $14.2 Billion Fab Deal and AI Momentum Lift the Chip Sector
title_zh: 英特尔股价上涨 8%，AMD 上涨 3%：142 亿美元的晶圆厂交易和人工智能势头提振芯片行业
summary: The chip sector is rallying Wednesday morning, with Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) shares up 8% and Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD) stock rising 3% in early trading.
summary_zh: 芯片行业周三上午上涨，英特尔 (NASDAQ:INTC) 股价在早盘交易中上涨 8%，Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD) 股价上涨 3%。

title: Carlyle enters $2.8bn deal to acquire majority of MAI Capital
title_zh: 凯雷投资 28 亿美元收购 MAI Capital 多数股权
summary: Galway Holdings, Harvest Partners, and Oak Hill Capital will exit their ownership positions.
summary_zh: Galway Holdings、Harvest Partners 和 Oak Hill Capital 将退出其所有权地位。
